title: Town of Souls
overview:
Soul Town Street connects the spirit realm and the human world; it is a place that absorbs the souls of the dead and suppresses evil spirits. Xia Ling is an ordinary college graduate who, by chance, enters one of the Soul Town Streets, Rakshasa Street.

In this street filled with evil spirits, Cao Yanbing, the Soul Guardian of Rakshasa Street, makes a dashing entrance, rescuing the damsel in distress.

title: Brothers
overview:
Years ago, Rakshasa Street was peaceful under the Cao family's rule. One night, General Cao and his wife received orders to go out and never returned, leaving behind only the young Cao Yanbing and the infant Cao Xuanliang.

Uninvited guests arrive in Rakshasa Street, and the two brothers face a crisis.

title: The Spirit Master
overview:
As soon as Xia Ling woke up, Cao Yanbing started clamoring to erase her memories. In the chaos, Cao Yanbing and Cao Xuanliang discovered a message left by Gui Fu Santong.

Xia Ling was also a spirit possessor, but Cao Yanbing couldn't sense any spiritual power in her.

title: The Vow
overview:
Brothers Cao Yanbing and Cao Xuanliang hid under a bridge in Luosha Street, surviving by scavenging for garbage.

A stranger named Ada claimed he could take the brothers to a place where they could eat and stay warm, but little did they know he was a human trafficker.

title: Kingdom Organization
overview:
Xia Ling finally found a job, and just as she was feeling happy, an uninvited guest suddenly arrived at her home.

A robot had its eye on the guardian spirit within her, but what exactly was this so-called Kingdom Organization?

title: Homeless
overview:
The two brothers return to Rakshasa Street and encounter Young Master Lu again.

After experiencing hardships, can the grown-up brothers defeat the wicked young master?

title: Welcome to Rakshasa Street
overview: To escape the Kingdom Organization's pursuit, Xia Ling hid in Rakshasa Street, but unexpectedly ended up working as a maid.

title: Liu Yuchan
overview:
After being sent to Dead Soul Island, the older brother suffers a lot of bullying. He is determined to go back and save his younger brother.

Can he successfully escape with the help of others?

title: The mountain is not high
overview: Cao Yanbing begins to seriously help Xia Ling train to become a powerful spirit master, with scenes of him splitting wooden boards with his iron head and holding his breath underwater in a wet and saturated manner.

title: Gentleness is a sin
overview:
After escaping Death Island, the older brother returns to Rakshasa Street with great difficulty to find his younger brother.

Will the younger brother be able to escape the search of the evil spirits until his older brother returns to save him?

title: Rain of Pear Blossoms
overview: After learning of the suspect in his parents' murder, Cao Yanbing began searching for him everywhere, only to fall into the enemy's trap.

title: New Vows
overview:
After overcoming countless hardships, the older brother finally rescued his younger brother from danger.

However, before they even left Rakshasa Street, an unexpected turn of events occurred: the mute older sister who had been caring for her brother suddenly transformed into an evil spirit, forcing the brothers to face a critical choice.

title: Heart-Locking Chain
overview: Xia Ling was unable to summon her guardian spirit, and Cao Yanbing, equally anxious, tried a risky approach, once again putting Xia Ling in danger.

title: Spirit Locust Branch
overview: After four years of cultivation, the Cao brothers have returned. Facing the ruthless Young Master Lu, can they reclaim their home?

title: Xia Ling's Choice
overview:
Xia Ling accidentally heard that the spirit locust branch could enhance spiritual power and was tempted, but Cao Yanbing blamed her for only wanting to take shortcuts.

Faced with his opposition, what choice will Xia Ling make?

title: For the Battles of the Past
overview:
Young Master Lu's spiritual power has greatly increased after eating the Spirit Tree Branch.

Can the two brothers, who rely on their own strength to fight, still defeat him?

title: Besieged on all sides
overview:
The Kingdom Organization finally broke through the barrier and entered Rakshasa Street.

To protect Xia Ling, Cao Yanbing charged into battle alone.

title: Humans and Ghosts Are Different
overview:
To protect his younger brother, the older brother faces the evil spirit that ate the spirit tree branch alone, fighting a lone battle in Rakshasa Street.

Meanwhile, the younger brother, who has no spiritual power, tries every means to return to Rakshasa Street.

title: The Ninth Knight
overview: To avoid implicating the undead, Cao Yanbing decided to take a different approach, but unwittingly played right into the Kingdom Organization's hands.

title: A Battle with No Way Out
overview:
The younger brother finally returns to Rakshasa Street and confronts Young Master Lu head-on.

Faced with the malevolent Young Master Lu, what kind of changes will occur between the two brothers...?

title: Unstoppable Momentum
overview:
After Cao Yanbing was lured out of Rakshasa Street, Xiao Liang and Xia Ling, left alone, were powerless to resist the Kingdom Organization's relentless advance.

What will Xia Ling do in this time of crisis...?

title: The Body of the Martial God
overview:
The younger brother, suffering from memory loss, acts according to Young Master Lu's will and turns against his older brother. When the older brother is unable to resist, what choice will the younger brother make...?

Meanwhile, on the other side, Yu Jin, who has always been loyal to his master, will take what actions to resist Young Master Lu...?

title: The Road to Kingship
overview:
Caught in a fierce battle, Cao Yanbing only wants a quick victory, but inadvertently discovers the secret of Gui Fu Santong.

Meanwhile, Rakshasa Street falls into chaos.

title: Dawn of Adventure
overview:
The mysterious man disguised as Gui Fu Santong reappears, with his identity exposed he violently destroys the Spirit Tree.

Xia Ling, deeply troubled by the destruction of the Spirit Tree embarks on a journey to repair it.
